title: HashMap vs ConcurrentHashMap
contentMd:
HashMap is the most commonly used implementation of the Map interface, offering O(1) average-time get and put operations. However, it is not thread-safe. If multiple threads modify a HashMap concurrently, especially during structural modifications such as put or remove, the internal structure can become corrupted and the iteration may throw a ConcurrentModificationException due to the fail-fast iterator.

ConcurrentHashMap, introduced in Java 5 and redesigned in Java 8, provides thread safety without locking the entire map. In Java 8 it uses an array of Node buckets, and each bucket is locked independently using a technique called lock striping combined with CAS (Compare-And-Swap) for insertion. Reads are generally lock-free, which makes concurrent reads very efficient. This allows many threads to read and write different segments of the map simultaneously.

Use HashMap when you do not need concurrent access, since it has the lowest overhead. Choose ConcurrentHashMap when multiple threads share a map and you want safe concurrent updates without the heavy synchronization cost of a fully locked Collections.synchronizedMap. Avoid using Hashtable, which locks the entire object on every method and is largely obsolete. Remember that ConcurrentHashMap does not support null keys or values, whereas HashMap does.
contentCn:
HashMap 是 Map 接口最常用的实现，提供 O(1) 平均时间复杂度的 get 和 put 操作。但它并非线程安全。如果多个线程并发修改 HashMap，尤其是在 put 或 remove 等结构性修改时，内部结构可能被破坏，并且由于 fail-fast（快速失败）迭代器，迭代过程可能抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。

ConcurrentHashMap 在 Java 5 中引入，并在 Java 8 中重新设计，它在不需要锁住整个映射的前提下提供了线程安全性。在 Java 8 中，它使用一个 Node 桶数组，每个桶通过称为分段锁（lock striping）的技术结合 CAS（比较并交换）进行独立加锁来实现插入操作。读取操作通常是无锁的，因此并发读取非常高效。这使得多个线程可以同时读写映射的不同部分。

当你不需要并发访问时，使用 HashMap，因为它的开销最低。当多个线程共享一个映射、且希望在不承受完全加锁的 Collections.synchronizedMap 高昂同步代价的情况下进行安全并发更新时，应选择 ConcurrentHashMap。应避免使用 Hashtable，因为它在每个方法上都会锁住整个对象，已基本被淘汰。注意 ConcurrentHashMap 不支持 null 键或值，而 HashMap 支持。

title: ArrayList vs LinkedList
contentMd:
ArrayList and LinkedList are two common implementations of the List interface, but they have very different internal structures. ArrayList is backed by a dynamic array, while LinkedList is implemented as a doubly linked list where each element holds references to both its previous and next nodes.

Because of these structures, their performance characteristics differ. ArrayList provides O(1) random access by index, but inserting or deleting elements in the middle requires shifting subsequent elements, costing O(n). LinkedList offers O(1) insertion and deletion at the head or tail (when you have a node reference), but random access requires traversing the list, costing O(n).

In practice, ArrayList is almost always the better default choice because modern CPUs cache contiguous memory very efficiently, and most real-world code reads more than it mutates in the middle. Use LinkedList only when you need frequent insertions and deletions at both ends, such as implementing a queue or deque. Otherwise, prefer ArrayList.
contentCn:
ArrayList 和 LinkedList 是 List 接口的两种常见实现，但它们的内部结构截然不同。ArrayList 由动态数组支撑，而 LinkedList 被实现为双向链表，每个元素都持有指向前一个和后一个节点的引用。

由于结构不同，它们的性能特征也有所差异。ArrayList 通过下标提供 O(1) 的随机访问，但在中间插入或删除元素需要移动后续元素，代价为 O(n)。LinkedList 在头部或尾部（当你持有节点引用时）提供 O(1) 的插入和删除，但随机访问需要遍历链表，代价为 O(n)。

在实践中，ArrayList 几乎总是更好的默认选择，因为现代 CPU 能非常高效地缓存连续内存，而且大多数真实代码的读取操作多于在中间位置的修改。仅当你需要频繁在两端进行插入和删除（例如实现队列或双端队列）时才使用 LinkedList。否则，应优先选择 ArrayList。

title: Fail-Fast vs Fail-Safe Iterators
contentMd:
A fail-fast iterator fails as soon as it detects that the collection has been structurally modified after the iterator was created, throwing a ConcurrentModificationException. Most iterators returned by standard Java collections such as ArrayList, HashMap, and HashSet are fail-fast. They track a modification count (modCount) and compare it during iteration.

A fail-safe iterator operates on a copy of the collection rather than the original, so it never throws ConcurrentModificationException even if the underlying collection changes during iteration. Iterators from concurrent collections such as CopyOnWriteArrayList and ConcurrentHashMap are effectively fail-safe, but they may not reflect the most recent changes made by other threads.

The trade-off is that fail-fast gives you immediate visibility of a bug but can abort iteration, while fail-safe avoids exceptions at the cost of potentially stale data and extra memory for the copy. In interviews, emphasize that fail-fast is about detecting concurrent modification, not guaranteeing thread safety, and that the best practice is to avoid modifying a collection while iterating over it.
contentCn:
fail-fast（快速失败）迭代器在检测到集合自迭代器创建后被结构性修改时，会立即失败并抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。ArrayList、HashMap 和 HashSet 等标准 Java 集合返回的迭代器大多是 fail-fast 的。它们跟踪一个修改计数（modCount）并在迭代过程中进行比较。

fail-safe（安全失败）迭代器操作的是集合的副本而非原集合，因此即使底层集合在迭代期间发生变化，也不会抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。CopyOnWriteArrayList 和 ConcurrentHashMap 等并发集合的迭代器本质上是 fail-safe 的，但它们可能无法反映其他线程所做的最新修改。

二者的权衡在于：fail-fast 能让你立即发现错误，但可能会中断迭代；而 fail-safe 以避免异常为代价，可能导致读取到过期数据，并因复制而产生额外的内存开销。在面试中，要强调 fail-fast 是为了检测并发修改，而非保证线程安全，最佳实践是在迭代集合时不要对其进行修改。
titleCn: 快速失败与安全失败迭代器

title: Thread vs Runnable
contentMd:
In Java, there are two classic ways to define a task to be executed by a thread: extending the Thread class or implementing the Runnable interface. Extending Thread couples your task with the thread mechanism itself, while implementing Runnable separates the task logic from the thread that runs it.

The recommended approach is to implement Runnable (or Callable) and pass it to a Thread or, better, to an ExecutorService. This keeps your code flexible: you can run the same Runnable in a thread, a thread pool, or a scheduled executor. It also avoids the single-inheritance limitation of Java, since a class that implements Runnable can still extend another class.

Modern Java favors higher-level abstractions. Since Java 5, prefer ExecutorService and tasks that implement Runnable or Callable over manually creating Thread objects. Since Java 8, you can pass a lambda expression directly where a Runnable is expected, making the code more concise and readable.
contentCn:
在 Java 中，定义由线程执行的任务有两种经典方式：继承 Thread 类或实现 Runnable 接口。继承 Thread 会将你的任务与线程机制本身耦合在一起，而实现 Runnable 则将任务逻辑与运行它的线程分离开来。

推荐的做法是实现 Runnable（或 Callable）接口，并将其传递给一个 Thread，或者更好的是传递给 ExecutorService。这样代码更灵活：同一个 Runnable 可以在线程、线程池或定时执行器中运行。它还避免了 Java 单继承的限制，因为实现了 Runnable 的类仍然可以继承另一个类。

现代 Java 更偏好高层次的抽象。自 Java 5 起，应优先使用 ExecutorService 以及实现 Runnable 或 Callable 的任务，而不是手动创建 Thread 对象。自 Java 8 起，你可以直接在需要 Runnable 的地方传入 lambda 表达式，使代码更简洁、可读性更强。

title: synchronized vs ReentrantLock
contentMd:
Both synchronized and ReentrantLock provide mutual exclusion, but they differ in flexibility. The synchronized keyword is built into the language, easy to use, and automatically releases the lock when the method or block exits, even via an exception. It is a reentrant lock managed entirely by the JVM.

ReentrantLock, part of the java.util.concurrent.locks package, offers more advanced features. It supports a non-blocking tryLock, lock attempts with a timeout, interruptible lock acquisition, and the ability to create fair locks. You must explicitly call unlock in a finally block, which makes it more error-prone but also more controllable.

In general, prefer synchronized for simple critical sections because it is simpler and less error-prone. Reach for ReentrantLock when you need features such as timed or interruptible locking, or strict fairness guarantees. Note that synchronized has been heavily optimized in modern JVMs, so its performance gap with ReentrantLock is often negligible for basic use.
contentCn:
synchronized 和 ReentrantLock 都提供互斥能力，但在灵活性上有所不同。synchronized 关键字是语言内建的，使用简单，并且在方法或代码块退出时（即使通过异常）会自动释放锁。它是由 JVM 完全管理的可重入锁。

ReentrantLock 属于 java.util.concurrent.locks 包，提供了更先进的功能。它支持非阻塞的 tryLock、带超时的加锁尝试、可中断的加锁获取，以及创建公平锁的能力。你必须在 finally 块中显式调用 unlock，这使得它更容易出错，但也更可控。

一般来说，对于简单的临界区应优先使用 synchronized，因为它更简单且不易出错。当你需要带超时或可中断的加锁，或严格的公平性保证时，再使用 ReentrantLock。注意，现代 JVM 已对 synchronized 做了大量优化，因此在基本用途上它与 ReentrantLock 的性能差距通常可以忽略不计。

title: ReentrantLock and AQS Internals
contentMd:
ReentrantLock is built on top of the AbstractQueuedSynchronizer (AQS), the foundational framework for most locks and synchronizers in java.util.concurrent. AQS manages a FIFO queue of threads waiting to acquire a lock and an integer state field that represents the synchronization state.

When a thread tries to acquire the lock, AQS uses a CAS operation to atomically update the state. If it succeeds, the thread becomes the owner; if it fails, the thread is wrapped into a node and parked (suspended) at the tail of the wait queue. When the owner releases the lock, AQS wakes the next waiting thread in the queue.

A key insight for interviews is that AQS separates the queuing and waking mechanics from the policy. Subclasses like ReentrantLock only decide how state is acquired and released (for example, tracking reentrant hold counts), while AQS handles the hard part of efficiently and fairly scheduling threads. This design is why many concurrent utilities share similar, well-tested behavior.
contentCn:
ReentrantLock 构建在 AbstractQueuedSynchronizer（AQS，抽象队列同步器）之上，AQS 是 java.util.concurrent 中大多数锁和同步器的基础框架。AQS 管理一个等待获取锁的线程的 FIFO 队列，并维护一个表示同步状态的整数 state 字段。

当线程尝试获取锁时，AQS 使用 CAS 操作来原子地更新状态。如果成功，该线程成为锁的持有者；如果失败，线程会被包装成一个节点，并 park（挂起）在等待队列的尾部。当持有者释放锁时，AQS 会唤醒队列中的下一个等待线程。

面试中的一个关键认知是，AQS 将排队和唤醒机制与策略分离开来。ReentrantLock 等子类只决定如何获取和释放状态（例如记录可重入的持有计数），而 AQS 负责高效地、公平地调度线程这一难题。正是由于这种设计，许多并发工具才共享相似且经过充分测试的底层行为。
titleCn: ReentrantLock 与 AQS 内部机制

title: Thread Pools and ExecutorService
contentMd:
A thread pool reuses a fixed number of threads to execute many tasks, avoiding the high cost of repeatedly creating and destroying threads. In Java, the ExecutorService interface and the Executors factory class provide convenient ways to create pools such as fixed-size, cached, and single-thread executors.

The most important parameters live in ThreadPoolExecutor: corePoolSize, maximumPoolSize, keepAliveTime, a work queue, and a thread factory plus rejection policy. When a task arrives, the pool creates core threads up to corePoolSize, then queues the task, and only creates extra threads up to maximumPoolSize when the queue is full. If everything is saturated, the rejection policy (such as AbortPolicy) handles it.

In production, avoid the convenient Executors.newFixedThreadPool and newCachedThreadPool because they use unbounded queues or unbounded thread counts that can exhaust memory. Prefer constructing a ThreadPoolExecutor explicitly with a bounded queue and a sensible rejection policy, and always remember to call shutdown() to release resources.
contentCn:
线程池复用固定数量的线程来执行大量任务，从而避免反复创建和销毁线程的高昂代价。在 Java 中，ExecutorService 接口和 Executors 工厂类提供了创建线程池的便捷方式，例如固定大小、缓存型和单线程执行器。

最重要的参数都在 ThreadPoolExecutor 中：corePoolSize（核心线程数）、maximumPoolSize（最大线程数）、keepAliveTime（空闲线程存活时间）、一个工作队列，以及线程工厂和拒绝策略。当任务到达时，线程池会先创建核心线程直到达到 corePoolSize，然后将任务入队；只有当队列满时，才会创建额外的线程直至 maximumPoolSize。如果一切都已饱和，拒绝策略（如 AbortPolicy）会处理它。

在生产环境中，应避免使用便捷的 Executors.newFixedThreadPool 和 newCachedThreadPool，因为它们分别使用了无界队列或无界线程数，可能导致内存耗尽。应优先显式构造 ThreadPoolExecutor，使用有界队列和合理的拒绝策略，并且始终记得调用 shutdown() 来释放资源。

title: Asynchronous Composition with CompletableFuture
contentMd:
CompletableFuture, introduced in Java 8, represents a future result of an asynchronous computation and provides a rich API for composing tasks without blocking. Unlike the older Future, it lets you chain callbacks such as thenApply, thenAccept, and thenCompose, and combine multiple futures with allOf or anyOf.

A common interview use case is calling several downstream services in parallel and aggregating their results. You can launch each call with CompletableFuture.supplyAsync, then use thenCombine to merge two results, or CompletableFuture.allOf to wait for all of them and then assemble the final response.

Be careful with thread pools: by default, async methods run on the shared ForkJoinPool.commonPool(), which can be exhausted by long-running or blocking tasks. For I/O-bound work, supply your own Executor. Also handle errors with exceptionally or handle, and always decide explicitly whether you want the result synchronously via join or get, or purely asynchronous pipelines.
contentCn:
CompletableFuture 在 Java 8 中引入，表示一个异步计算未来的结果，并提供丰富的 API 用于组合任务而无需阻塞。与较早的 Future 不同，它允许你链式调用 thenApply、thenAccept、thenCompose 等回调，并通过 allOf 或 anyOf 将多个 future 组合在一起。

面试中常见的使用场景是并行调用多个下游服务并聚合其结果。你可以用 CompletableFuture.supplyAsync 启动每个调用，然后使用 thenCombine 合并两个结果，或用 CompletableFuture.allOf 等待所有调用完成后再组装最终响应。

要小心线程池：默认情况下，异步方法运行在共享的 ForkJoinPool.commonPool() 上，而长时间运行或阻塞型任务可能耗尽它。对于 I/O 密集型任务，应提供你自己的 Executor。同时要用 exceptionally 或 handle 来处理错误，并明确决定是要通过 join 或 get 同步获取结果，还是纯粹使用异步流水线。
titleCn: 使用 CompletableFuture 进行异步编排

title: CAS and Lock-Free Programming
contentMd:
CAS, or Compare-And-Swap, is a CPU-level atomic instruction that updates a variable only if its current value equals an expected value, returning whether the swap succeeded. It is the foundation of lock-free programming in Java and underpins classes in the java.util.concurrent.atomic package.

The typical pattern is a loop: read the current value, compute the new value, and attempt CAS; if another thread changed the value meanwhile, the CAS fails and the loop retries with the fresh value. This is called optimistic locking because threads do not block each other but retry on conflict.

CAS avoids the overhead of locking but is not free. It can suffer from the ABA problem, where a value changes from A to B and back to A, making CAS think nothing changed. AtomicStampedReference solves this by pairing the value with a version stamp. Also, heavy contention can cause many retries, so CAS shines best under low to moderate contention.
contentCn:
CAS（Compare-And-Swap，比较并交换）是一种 CPU 级别的原子指令，它仅当变量的当前值等于预期值时才更新该变量，并返回交换是否成功。它是 Java 中无锁编程的基础，也是 java.util.concurrent.atomic 包中各类的底层支撑。

典型模式是一个循环：读取当前值，计算新值，然后尝试 CAS；如果期间另一个线程修改了该值，CAS 就会失败，循环会用最新的值重试。这被称为乐观锁，因为线程之间不会相互阻塞，而是在冲突时重试。

CAS 避免了加锁的开销，但并非没有代价。它可能遭遇 ABA 问题，即某个值从 A 变为 B 又变回 A，使 CAS 误以为没有发生变化。AtomicStampedReference 通过将值与版本戳配对来解决这个问题。此外，在高度竞争下可能导致大量重试，因此 CAS 在低到中等竞争程度下表现最佳。

title: Atomic Classes in Java
contentMd:
The java.util.concurrent.atomic package provides lock-free, thread-safe variables for single-value atomic operations. Common classes include AtomicInteger, AtomicLong, AtomicBoolean, and AtomicReference, each offering methods such as getAndIncrement, compareAndSet, and lazySet.

These classes are useful for counters, flags, and simple state that must be updated safely by multiple threads. For example, an AtomicInteger hit counter can be incremented concurrently without explicit synchronization, and the operation is performed with a fast CAS instruction rather than a heavyweight lock.

For aggregated or field-level atomicity, consider LongAdder when high contention is expected, because it spreads updates across multiple cells to reduce contention. Also note AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater and the newer VarHandle API for fine-grained, low-overhead access to volatile fields. Choose atomic classes over synchronized when you only need to atomically update a single variable.
contentCn:
java.util.concurrent.atomic 包为单值原子操作提供了无锁、线程安全的变量。常见的类包括 AtomicInteger、AtomicLong、AtomicBoolean 和 AtomicReference，它们各自提供了 getAndIncrement、compareAndSet 和 lazySet 等方法。

这些类非常适用于必须由多个线程安全更新的计数器、标志位和简单状态。例如，AtomicInteger 形式的访问计数器可以被并发地递增而无需显式同步，并且该操作是通过快速的 CAS 指令而非重量级锁来完成的。

当预期会有高度竞争时，对于聚合或字段级别的原子性，可考虑使用 LongAdder，因为它将更新分散到多个单元格中以减少竞争。另外，还有 AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater 以及更新的 VarHandle API，用于以细粒度、低开销的方式访问 volatile 字段。当你只需要原子地更新单个变量时，应优先选择原子类而非 synchronized。

title: Deadlock Causes and Prevention
contentMd:
A deadlock occurs when two or more threads are blocked forever, each waiting for a resource held by the other. In Java, deadlocks most often arise from nested synchronized blocks that acquire multiple locks in inconsistent orders across threads.

For example, if thread A locks resource X then tries to lock Y, while thread B locks Y then tries to lock X, the two may each hold one lock and wait indefinitely for the other. Deadlocks require four conditions: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait. Breaking any one prevents the deadlock.

Prevention techniques include always acquiring locks in a consistent global order, using a single lock for related resources, preferring timed tryLock with ReentrantLock, and keeping synchronized blocks as small as possible. At runtime you can detect deadlocks using jstack or JConsole, which can dump thread states and reveal the cycle of waiting threads.
contentCn:
死锁是指两个或多个线程永远相互阻塞，各自等待对方持有的资源。在 Java 中，死锁最常源于以不一致的顺序跨线程获取多个锁的嵌套 synchronized 代码块。

例如，如果线程 A 先锁住资源 X 再尝试锁住 Y，而线程 B 先锁住 Y 再尝试锁住 X，两者可能各自持有一把锁并无限等待对方。死锁需要满足四个条件：互斥、持有并等待、不可抢占，以及循环等待。打破其中任意一个即可防止死锁。

预防技术包括：始终以一致的全局顺序获取锁、对相关资源使用单一锁、优先使用 ReentrantLock 的带超时 tryLock，以及尽可能缩小 synchronized 代码块的范围。在运行时，你可以使用 jstack 或 JConsole 检测死锁，它们可以导出线程状态并揭示等待线程的循环依赖。

title: ThreadLocal and Its Pitfalls
contentMd:
ThreadLocal provides thread-local variables: each thread that accesses a ThreadLocal gets its own, independently initialized copy of the variable. It is commonly used to hold per-thread state such as a database connection, a user session, or a SimpleDateFormat instance, which is not thread-safe.

Internally, each Thread has a ThreadLocalMap, and the ThreadLocal object acts as the key. When a thread calls get or set, the value is stored in that thread's own map, so no locking is needed and there is no contention between threads.

The classic pitfall is memory leaks in server applications using thread pools. Because pooled threads live long and reuse their ThreadLocalMap, values set but never removed can accumulate. Always call remove() in a finally block when you are done, especially in web frameworks where the same thread handles many requests across different users.
contentCn:
ThreadLocal 提供线程局部变量：每个访问 ThreadLocal 的线程都会获得该变量属于自己的、独立初始化的副本。它常用于保存每个线程的状态，例如数据库连接、用户会话，以及非线程安全的 SimpleDateFormat 实例。

在内部，每个 Thread 都有一个 ThreadLocalMap，而 ThreadLocal 对象充当其中的键。当线程调用 get 或 set 时，值被存储在该线程自己的 map 中，因此不需要加锁，线程之间也不存在竞争。

经典的陷阱是在使用线程池的服务器应用中发生内存泄漏。由于池化线程存活时间长且会复用其 ThreadLocalMap，被设置却从未被移除的值会不断累积。使用完毕后务必在 finally 块中调用 remove()，尤其是在同一个线程会处理来自不同用户多个请求的 Web 框架中。

title: CopyOnWriteArrayList Explained
contentMd:
CopyOnWriteArrayList is a thread-safe List implementation where all mutating operations (add, set, remove) create a fresh copy of the underlying array. Reads operate on the current snapshot without any locking, which makes reads extremely cheap and safe under concurrency.

This design is ideal for read-heavy, write-rarely scenarios such as listener lists or configuration caches, where iteration happens far more often than modification. Because the iterator works on a snapshot taken at creation time, it is fail-safe and never throws ConcurrentModificationException.

The trade-off is memory and latency: every write copies the entire array, so writes are O(n) and can be expensive under frequent updates. Also, a reader may see a slightly stale snapshot. Use CopyOnWriteArrayList only when reads vastly outnumber writes; otherwise prefer a synchronized list or ConcurrentHashMap-backed structure.
contentCn:
CopyOnWriteArrayList 是一种线程安全的 List 实现，其所有变更操作（add、set、remove）都会创建底层数组的一个全新副本。读取操作在当前的快照上进行，且无需任何加锁，这使得并发读取极其廉价和安全。

这种设计非常适合读多写少的场景，例如监听器列表或配置缓存，其中迭代的频率远高于修改。由于迭代器工作在创建时获取的快照上，它是 fail-safe 的，永远不会抛出 ConcurrentModificationException。

其代价在于内存和延迟：每次写入都会复制整个数组，因此写入的时间复杂度为 O(n)，在频繁更新时开销很大。此外，读取者可能会看到一个略微过期的快照。仅当读取操作远多于写入时才使用 CopyOnWriteArrayList；否则应优先选择同步列表或基于 ConcurrentHashMap 的结构。

title: BlockingQueue for Producer-Consumer
contentMd:
A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe queue that supports operations which block when the queue is empty (on take) or full (on put). It is the standard coordination primitive between producer and consumer threads and is widely used inside thread pools and task pipelines.

Java provides several implementations. ArrayBlockingQueue is a bounded queue backed by an array; LinkedBlockingQueue is optionally bounded and based on linked nodes; PriorityBlockingQueue orders elements by priority; and SynchronousQueue hands tasks directly from producer to consumer with no buffering.

In practice, choosing the right implementation matters. A bounded queue such as ArrayBlockingQueue prevents unbounded memory growth and enables sensible rejection policies in thread pools. Blocking methods like put and take simplify producer-consumer code because they handle waiting and waking for you, removing the need for manual wait/notify loops.
contentCn:
BlockingQueue 是一种线程安全的队列，支持在队列为空（take 时）或已满（put 时）时阻塞的操作。它是生产者线程与消费者线程之间标准的协调原语，被广泛应用于线程池和任务流水线中。

Java 提供了多种实现。ArrayBlockingQueue 是由数组支撑的有界队列；LinkedBlockingQueue 基于链表节点，可配置为有界或无界；PriorityBlockingQueue 按优先级对元素排序；而 SynchronousQueue 不提供缓冲，直接将任务从生产者交给消费者。

在实践中，选择合适实现很重要。像 ArrayBlockingQueue 这样的有界队列能防止内存无限制增长，并在线程池中启用合理的拒绝策略。put 和 take 等阻塞方法简化了生产者-消费者代码，因为它们替你处理了等待与唤醒，无需手动编写 wait/notify 循环。

title: How HashMap Works Internally
contentMd:
A HashMap stores entries in an array of buckets, and the bucket index for a key is derived from the hash of its key. Java computes a secondary hash to spread keys evenly and then uses (n - 1) & hash to find the bucket, which is why the array length is always a power of two.

Each bucket holds a linked list of entries (or a balanced tree in Java 8+ when a bucket grows beyond eight entries). Collisions are resolved by chaining. The load factor, default 0.75, controls when the map resizes: when the number of entries exceeds capacity times load factor, the array is doubled and all entries are rehashed into the new buckets.

Resizing is an expensive O(n) operation, so choosing an appropriate initial capacity matters for performance-critical code. In Java 8, when a bucket becomes too large it converts to a red-black tree, improving worst-case lookup from O(n) to O(log n). Understanding these internals helps you tune capacity and avoid hash collisions in interviews.
contentCn:
HashMap 将条目存储在一个桶数组中，键所对应的桶索引由其键的哈希值推导而来。Java 会计算一个二次哈希以使键分布均匀，然后使用 (n - 1) & hash 来找到桶的位置，这也解释了为什么数组长度始终是 2 的幂。

每个桶中保存着一个条目的链表（在 Java 8+ 中，当某个桶的条目超过 8 个时会转为平衡树）。冲突通过链式法解决。负载因子（默认 0.75）控制映射何时扩容：当条目数量超过容量乘以负载因子时，数组会翻倍，并且所有条目会被重新哈希到新的桶中。

扩容是一个代价为 O(n) 的昂贵操作，因此在性能攸关的代码中，选择合适的初始容量很重要。在 Java 8 中，当某个桶过大时会转换为红黑树，从而将最坏情况下的查找复杂度从 O(n) 提升到 O(log n)。理解这些内部机制有助于你在面试中调优容量并避免哈希冲突。
